name: RogueBite
detailed_description:
Overview

RogueBite is a fast-paced rogue-lite reverse bullet hell, designed for local co-op play with two players. Whether using a keyboard or controller, players must work together to survive against relentless waves of enemies, aiming to reach the highest wave possible.

Gameplay & Controls

Players control their characters using either the keyboard or the left stick of a controller, moving horizontally, vertically and diagonally. In addition to their automated passive attacks, players can trigger active abilities via designated action buttons. These abilities provide more control over the battlefield and encourage cooperative strategy.

Game Loop

The core objective is survival—players must endure increasingly intense waves of enemies, each lasting a set duration. After surviving a wave, players can: - Select character upgrades to enhance their attributes. - Visit the shop to purchase new gear and perks. - Equip items into one of four available slots, tailoring their loadout for upcoming challenges. With each wave, the difficulty escalates, demanding quick reflexes, strategic cooperation, and smart resource management. How deep can you go?
